plan.title: Save eRFX RFQ Project as Draft

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Configure the project with only an RFQ stage.
Verify that Auction and other stages are not part of the final project.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and items.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Verify that an RFQ template was applied.
Add the requested CYLINDER product with quantity 10.
Verify that exactly one line item was added.
Populate the RFQ sheet so the draft has its required pricing-sheet data.
Set the requested delivery location for the first line item.
Verify that the delivery location was retained in the sheet.
Save the configured project as a draft.
Verify that Procol reports the draft save succeeded.
Return to the events list to verify the saved draft.
Verify that the saved project is listed among drafts.
